question: Which among the following acids is found in coconut oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lauric acid.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lauric acid:-**

It is a medium-chain saturated fatty acid that is found in coconut oil in high concentrations.

 
• It makes up about 50% of the total fatty acid content in coconut oil.
